execution_policy.quality: Do not reduce reasoning, verification, or implementation quality to save tokens. Save tokens only by excluding irrelevant context and repeated explanations.
execution_policy.content_policy: Use only owner-approved facts, headings, and intent from canonical REQ-CONTENT requirements. Do not invent explanatory copy to fill gaps.

tasks.title: Fix git-status parsing in the lifecycle gate scripts
tasks.goal: Repair the shared git status --porcelain parsing so the first changed entry is never corrupted (e.g. src/... becoming rc/...), keeping scope enforcement fully strict, with regression tests proving the parser on modified/added/deleted/renamed/multiple entries and significant whitespace.
evidence: npm run audit:scope failed for P1-contract with the phantom path 'rc/data/guideDeck.ts' while git status showed ' M src/data/guideDeck.ts' — the whole-output trim strips the first entry's leading status space before slice(3) parses it.
acceptance: One canonical status parser is used by all four gate scripts and never trims the raw porcelain block before parsing entries.
Regression tests cover a modified first entry, added, deleted and renamed entries, multiple entries, preserved significant whitespace, and prove no phantom path is produced.
Scope checking is not weakened, no path special-cases are added, and no baseline is regenerated to mask the defect.
Pre-existing uncommitted P1 work in src/data/guideDeck.ts and tests/deck-invariants.test.ts is preserved byte-for-byte and left uncommitted.
npm run check passes.
notes: The P1-contract implementation already sitting uncommitted in the working tree is pre-existing dirt for this task: fingerprint-preserved, not committed here.
Do not mix P0.6 and P1 changes in one commit.
